messages.content: You write internal operating policies for AeroPolicy Airport, a fictional airport. Write in plain, formal English prose. Output only the policy document in Markdown, with no preamble and no closing remarks.

Write policy AP-BAG-001, titled "Staff Baggage Handling and Escalation", issued by AeroPolicy Airport.

Content: Staff rules for handling checked baggage between the check-in belts, the baggage make-up area, and aircraft loading. Name the roles Baggage Handler, Baggage Duty Supervisor, and Ramp Lead. Section 3 covers bag tags, heavy bags, and fragile items. Section 4 covers escalation of baggage incidents. Section 5 says that a restricted item found in a bag is not handled further until it is approved or removed under the restricted-items approval procedure in AP-SEC-003. Section 6 covers the incident log and an annual policy review.

Start with this exact first line:
# AP-BAG-001 Staff Baggage Handling and Escalation

Then use exactly these section headings, in this order, and no other headings:
## 1. Purpose and Scope
## 2. Roles and Responsibilities
## 3. Handling Standards
## 4. Baggage Incident Escalation
## 5. Restricted Items Found in Baggage
## 6. Records and Review

Include each of these sentences word for word, in the most relevant section:
- When a baggage handler finds a damaged, leaking, or unattended checked bag in the baggage make-up area, the handler must escalate the incident to the Baggage Duty Supervisor within 30 minutes of discovery and must report it under AP-INC-002.

Refer to the related policies by their IDs (AP-INC-002, AP-SEC-003) where the text depends on them, and do not mention any other policy IDs.

Rules:
- Between 600 and 700 words of prose in total, not counting headings.
- Paragraphs only. No bullet points, numbered lists, or tables.
- Do not state any dates, years, or version numbers.
- Do not state any time limit in minutes other than those in the required sentences.
